product_metadata.title: Evelots Bacon Grease Container with Fine Mesh Strainer-Large 5-Cups Stainless Cooking Oil Can for Kitchen Fat Storage with Easy-Grip Handle
features: Flavor Saver: Evelots Large capacity grease container can strain and store up to 5 cups (1.25 quart or 42 fl. oz.). Savvy cooks love using saved-up bacon drippings as a flavor booster fried eggs, pancakes and more. Do not Waste! Strain and reuse your bacon grease and other oils for future frying

High Quality: Made from food-grade, dishwasher-safe stainless steel. Our grease container features a removable fine mesh strainer basket. Its comfy grip handle and convenient pour spot. The design makes it simple to strain and store. Secure top protects oil or grease from dust or food particles

Multifunctional: This oil filter pot is perfect for keeping bacon grease, fat and oils for future cooking. The kitchen crock can also be use to brew loose tea, strain lumps from gravy, even sift flour.
Perfect Size: Our 5-cup grease container for your kitchen measures a compact 6 Inches Long x 5 Inches Wide x 5.5 Inches High overall
From our Vermont home to yours: For over 10 years, Evelots has offered customers unique products with a 30-day easy return policy.
